name: plan-window
description: Shows plan's issues in the Explorer and opens an issue's Claude terminal, shell and ticket in the plan window, and opens plan browse's pages in the integrated browser.

plan.issuesFile.description: plan's issues file: one issue key per line, one Issues item each. Matches issuesFile in plan's config.

plan.command.description: The plan CLI the window runs to clear an issue's colour (plan pulse <KEY> off).

plan.pulsesFile.description: plan's pulses file: <KEY>=orange or <KEY>=green lines that colour the Issues items. Matches pulsesFile in plan's config.

plan.workspaceDir.description: Where plan start writes each issue's <KEY>.code-workspace, read for its worktree, ticket and prompt. Matches workspaceDir in plan's config.
